'''Josh Mitchell''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Austin tournament]] on 10 June 2000 with Profit / X-wing swarm (?), according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d869">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-10-austin-tx-6-10d869/ austin-tx-6-10], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 10 June 2000).
